steps.name: The Wizard's Court
steps.wikiText: The Wizard's Court is located within the Inner Sanctorium. This is where the members of the Wizard's Court meet to administer and make decisions.

steps.name: Hall of Gallantry
steps.wikiText: Hall of Gallantry is an area on the first level of the Outer Sanctorium-the second floor The Wizard's Tower, serving as a gate for raid encounters from the Secrets of the Obscure expansion, as well as related services, can be accessed.

steps.name: Rift Hunter Lounge
steps.wikiText: The Rift Hunter Lounge is as the base of operations for the Rift Hunters within the Outer Sanctorium of The Wizard's Tower.

steps.name: Forge of Timelessness
steps.wikiText: The Forge of Timelessness is a point of interest found in the Outer Ring within The Wizard's Tower. Lyhr can be found here.

steps.name: Empyrean Plaza
steps.wikiText: Empyrean Plaza is a central plaza where the Mystic Forge is located, and is located within the Outer Ring.

steps.name: Tower Courtyard Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Outer Ring is an area located within The Wizard's Tower. And it is where the Mystic Forge, the Craftings, the bank and among other services are located.

steps.name: Amnytas Connector
steps.wikiText: Amnytas Connector is a portal found in the Outer Ring. Connects to the Amnytas zone.

steps.name: Lion's Arch Connector
steps.wikiText: Lion's Arch Connector a gate that connects to the city of Lion's Arch.

steps.name: Astral Ward Barracks
steps.wikiText: The Astral Ward Barracks it is located in the Outer Ring. It is where the bedrooms of the Astral Ward are located and housed.

steps.name: Memory's Gaze
steps.wikiText: Memory's Gaze is the memorial site for the Astral Ward. It is located on the second floor of The Wizard's Tower.

steps.name: Training Platform
steps.wikiText: The Training Platform it is located inside the Outer Sanctorium. It is used for training witches where they practice their combat skills, here you can see a djinn and a human training.

steps.name: Wizard's Vault
steps.wikiText: Wizard's Vault is a rewards system available to all players, replacing the previous daily login reward format and its generic daily achievements.

steps.name: The Reliquary
steps.wikiText: The Reliquary is a point of interest within the Inner Sanctorium. It is a place where various relics from the world of Tyria are kept. Livia can be found inside the place.

steps.name: Lyhr's Quarters
steps.wikiText: The Lyhr's Quarters are located within the Inner Sanctorium. It houses Lyhr's living quarters and workspace. At the site you can find a statue of King Jalis Ironhammer and a small forge.

steps.name: Dagda's Quarters
steps.wikiText: The Dagda's Quarters are located within the Inner Sanctorium. It houses Dagda's home and workspace.

steps.name: War Room
steps.wikiText: The War Room is an upgrade and location within Guild halls, run and maintained by a War Room Proprietor.

steps.name: Refugee Clinic
steps.wikiText: Refugee Clinic is a point of interest within Outer Sanctorium. It is a tent in where the Astral Ward tends to their wounded.

steps.name: Isgarren's Quarters
steps.wikiText: Isgarren's Quarters are located within the Inner Sanctorium. It houses Isgarren's home and workspace, where Archivist Benny can be found taking care of Isgarren's astral cat, Mingoo, during his absence.

steps.name: Mabon's Quarters
steps.wikiText: Mabon's Quarters are located within the Inner Sanctorium. It houses Mabon's home and in the place you can find some objects such as his work space.

steps.name: Mystic Passage
steps.wikiText: Mystic Passage it is the first place you enter when you reach The Wizard's Tower and connects to Beacon of Ages.

steps.name: Inner Sanctorium
steps.wikiText: Inner Sanctorium is an area in The Wizard's Tower where the personal quarters of the members of the Astral Ward are located. As well as the The Wizard's Court, along with the War Room.

steps.name: Outer Ring
steps.wikiText: The Outer Ring is an area located within The Wizard's Tower. And it is where the Mystic Forge, the Craftings, the bank and among other services are located.

steps.name: Wizard's Respite
steps.wikiText: The Wizard's Respite is a point of interest located within the Open Sky. At it is a small pond and a relaxation area.

steps.name: Open Sky
steps.wikiText: The Open Sky is an area encircling the northern side of the The Wizard's Tower, only one floating island can be found which is the Wizard's Respite.

steps.name: Dream Connector
steps.wikiText: Dream Connector is a door located in the Outer Ring. It connects with the Inner Nayos.

steps.name: Isgarren's Hidden Library
steps.wikiText: The Isgarren's Hidden Library is a point of interest found in the Outer Ring within The Wizard's Tower. The entrance to the library is closed, so it is not possible to access the interior.

steps.name: Wizard's Trial
steps.wikiText: The Wizard's Trial is a point of interest located inside the Outer Sanctorium, in the Wizard's Tower. In it, there is a door that gives access to the Wizard's Trial Race.

steps.name: Skyscale Stables
steps.wikiText: The Skyscale Stables are located in the Outer Ring. It is a covered space intended for the accommodation of the Skyscales, which serve the Astral Ward.
